emails.subject: PS Forwarding's move to the cloud
emails.html:
Hello,

I read that Albacore Systems moved PS Forwarding's servers and core business systems to a private cloud this summer. With air and sea forwarding and importer and exporter of record work run from Colnbrook, your team must turn a steady flow of rate requests into quotes.

We are Tiph, a software company in London, and we built Kazinga for the quoting side of a forwarder's day. It uses AI to read incoming rate requests, then prices them from your own tariffs and margin, and drafts the reply. Your team checks every quote and sends it. Your data is stored in the EU and encrypted, and Tiph cannot read it. More about Kazinga: https://tiph.agency/products/kazinga

We can also set Kazinga up to quote each customer from their own past quotes and orders, as a customisation aimed at raising the value of each account.

Would a 20-minute demo be useful?

Kind regards,
Ratif Ssemujju
